claims.source_quote_ar: الطبع جار مجرى الكناية عن عنادهم ولجاجهم
claims.claim_ar: كناية في عبارة «نَطْبَعُ عَلَى قُلُوبِ الْمُعْتَدِينَ»؛ فـ"الطبع" كناية عن العناد واللجاج.
claims.claim_en: A kenāyah (metonymic/figurative expression) in the phrase "نَطْبَعُ عَلَى قُلُوبِ الْمُعْتَدِينَ" — 'the imprint' (طبع) stands as a kināyah for stubbornness and obstinacy.
claims.rhetorical_effect: Portrays moral stubbornness as an ingrained 'imprint' on the hearts, making the opposition seem inherent and immutable.

claims.source_quote_ar: فما وقع فصل بين حالتيهم بعد بعثة الرسل وقبلها، كأن لم يبعث إليهم أحد
claims.claim_ar: تعليق التفسير يشير إلى غياب (أو عدم وقوع) فصل بين حالتيهم قبل بعثة الرسل وبعدها، أي استمرار حالهم كما لو لم تُبعَث إليهم رسل — تأثير بلاغي يؤكد ثبات عنادهم.
claims.claim_en: The commentary notes that 'no separation occurred between their states before and after the sending of messengers,' i.e. their condition continued as if no messengers had been sent — a rhetorical continuity (fasl/wasl) that emphasizes the persistence of their obstinacy.
claims.needs_review_reason: Mapping the commentator's use of the word فصل (separation) to the rhetorical device label 'fasl_wasl' is interpretive; the source states the observation but does not explicitly name the rhetorical figure.
claims.rhetorical_effect: Creates a sense of uninterrupted moral condition in the people — their rejection is framed as continuous and ineradicable.

claims.source_quote_ar: كَذَلِكَ نَطْبَعُ مثل ذلك الطبع المحكم نطبع عَلى قُلُوبِ الْمُعْتَدِينَ
claims.claim_ar: استخدام «كَذَلِكَ» كأداة تقرير/تلخيص تربط المثال السابق بالحكم العام «نَطْبَعُ...»؛ أسلوب حكيم يلخّص النتيجة ويعممها.
claims.claim_en: Use of the particle 'كَذَلِكَ' to sum up and link the preceding scenario to the general pronouncement 'نَطْبَعُ...' — a concise, wise-stylistic summarizing device (aslūb ḥākim) that generalizes the lesson.
claims.needs_review_reason: Identifying the particle as 'asloob_hakim' (wise/style device) is interpretive; the source gives the phrase and exposition but does not explicitly label the particle as a named rhetorical figure.
claims.rhetorical_effect: Condenses the example into a general doctrinal statement, enhancing memorability and imparting a moral lesson about persistent disbelief.
